# build reasonable: connect diagonal 1 pairs; 6 each extended along diagonal orientation of corresponding nearest 1-pair, and avoid overwriting 1
code='''def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 ones=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
 pairs=[]
 for i,(r,c) in enumerate(ones):
  for R,C in ones[i+1:]:
   if abs(R-r)==abs(C-c):
    s=1 if (R-r)*(C-c)>0 else -1; pairs.append((r,c,R,C,s))
    dr=1 if R>r else -1; dc=1 if C>c else -1
    for k in range(abs(R-r)+1): out[r+dr*k][c+dc*k]=1
 # diagonal 6 rays/lines; direction perpendicular to closest 1 pair
 sixes=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==6]
 for r,c in sixes:
  s=1
  if pairs:
   _,_,_,_,ps=min(pairs,key=lambda p:abs((r-c) if p[4]==1 else (r+c)))
   s=-ps
  for rr in range(h):
   cc=c+s*(rr-r)
   if 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]!=1: out[rr][cc]=6
 return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code); exec(compile(code,'x','exec')); o=transform(g); print(o)
